232081762_ce80332f.text: Trilaminar and back propagating interneurons are also found in CA1 SO and present with oblong cells bodies with dendrites that extend perpendicular to pyramidal CA1 neurons (Sik et al., 1994)(Sik et al., 1995). It is unlikely that LTH cells are trilaminar cells considering trilaminar cells do not express a sag and rebound response (Gloveli et al., 2005).
